source_metadata.cell_calling_policy: Own fixed RNAQC, not a reproduction of author final cell/doublet/cluster selection. Model labels unrestricted; no independently biologically validated annotation or doublet-free claim.
source_metadata.gene_policy: All33538original RNA feature IDs and symbols retained in exact supplied order. No highly variable gene selection, symbol modernization, intersection or zero filling.
source_metadata.count_semantics: Provided original CellRanger gene UMI counts; no inverse normalization or rounding.
source_metadata.source_limitations: Four selected repeated participants; source ascertainment/composition bias preserved. Exact demographics/days/outcomes and global aliases unresolved. No biological annotation, clinical efficacy or constellation validation.
